_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: At the table he is troubled in spirit.
One who dips the bread will betray him.
He gives the morsel, and Judas goes out.
And it was night.
Yet now the Son of Man is glorified.
We run the race set before us; come, let us worship.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: He dips the morsel and holds it out across the table, to the one whose heart is already turned away.
The hour has come.
Judas takes the bread and rises; the door opens, the dark pours in, and it was night.
The hour has come.
He gave his back to those who struck him and did not hide his face from shame, the witness who endured the cross.
The hour has come.
Make haste, O God, to help us; let us run with our eyes fixed on him. Come, let us worship.
The hour has come. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: He hands the bread to the betrayer, and Judas goes out.
The hour has come.
The door opens on the dark, and it was night.
The hour has come.
Yet the Son of Man is glorified; come, let us worship.
The hour has come. Amen.
